notes: Sanctum of All. Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' At turn 3's upkeep seat 0 fires the may and searches both zones (option 0): it takes Shrine G from the graveyard, and exactly one Shrine comes (Shrine L stays in the library). Its library WAS searched, so it is shuffled although the card came from the graveyard (the seeded order below; unshuffled it would be Library 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, Shrine L).
